title: Ironwood: Delivering Best in Class perf, perf/TCO and perf/Watt for Reasoning Model Training and Serving
problem: Reasoning models (e.g., OpenAI o1, DeepSeek-R1) require massive compute for both training and inference with long-horizon thinking patterns; Ironwood targets optimal performance, TCO, and energy efficiency for this emerging workload class.
motivation: Reasoning models fundamentally change workload characteristics (longer token sequences, more compute per token, novel memory access patterns); existing GPUs/TPUs may not be optimized for reasoning-specific compute and memory requirements.
method: Ironwood likely combines enhanced memory bandwidth for extended compute/token reasoning traces, optimized matrix multiplication for reasoning compute patterns, and possibly novel interconnect/collective operation support tailored to reasoning model parallelization strategies.
key_novelty: Hardware architecture specifically optimized for reasoning model training and serving, balancing performance, cost, and energy efficiency.
contributions: Hardware optimized for reasoning model compute and memory patterns
Best-in-class performance/TCO ratio for reasoning model deployment
Optimized energy efficiency for reasoning model training
Demonstrated scalability for multi-chip reasoning model systems

metrics.energy_or_tops_w: optimized energy efficiency vs. x86/GPU alternatives

primary_theme: Hardware for reasoning model training and serving
